Name: (AT) Giant Forageable Junimo Huts
Author: AtomicDiamond
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/L8j2MqW.png[/img]﻿[/center][size=4][center]Looking for some new companions to your fields of giant crops? Give your junimos a natural home among your fields of green with giant forageable-looking huts![/center]


[center][img]https://imgur.com/JoTyUrf.png[/img]﻿[/center][/size][size=3]
This mod depends on the Alternative Textures framework.
If you don't have the Alternative Textures framework downloaded, or need to update to the latest version, click the following link: 
Alternative Textures: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246[/url]﻿
[/size]
[size=3]After you've downloaded the Alternative Textures mod, download this mod and unpack with the rest of your mods. If you're new to modding, or need a refresher, start here: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Index]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Index

[/url]**If you have a mod that allows your Junimos the ability to work through the winter, I recommend installing the "No Doors" version. It can be found under the files section of this mod, and in the "Optional Files" section.



[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/lZ6hrCB.png[/img]﻿[/center][/size]
[size=3]After you've loaded into your game (and have Junimo huts built on your farm), you'll need to make use to of some of the tools from the Alternative Textures framework.

[/size][size=3]The tools can be purchased from Robin's. Use the paint bucket selecting it in your menu and left click on a Junimo Hut. A menu to select an alternative textures will open for you.
[/size][size=3]
Alternative Texture #1 will rotate the hut's appearance based on the season
[img]https://imgur.com/Srmp8CP.png[/img]Giant Leek for the Spring,
[img]https://imgur.com/5Ac6hVz.png[/img]Giant Spiceberry for the Summer,
[img]https://imgur.com/DAjcc5U.png[/img]Giant Hazelnut for the fall,
[img]https://imgur.com/7LEfCyA.png[/img]Giant Snow Yam for the winter.

Alternatively, you can select Texture #2 through #5 for a particular crop, any season of the year!

Enjoy giving your little junimo friends a new home on the farm!



[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/lTGZYN5.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[/size]﻿
[size=3]I'm AtomicDiamond, and I love stardew valley, pokemon, and pixel art! 

My first mod, Giant Crop Junimo Huts, was released before the giant powdermelon was a thing. So, in order to fill that giant-crop winter-gap, I created a custom snow-yam hut! Without wanting to discard my icy creation completely, I decided to complete a seasonal forageable-themed huts. Thus, my newest line of huts were born!

The original huts were inspired by ArgonMatrix VODs on YouTube, so a special shoutout to my fellow Canadian (and chat!) if you're finding your way here from there!

If you'd prefer a more "canonical" visual, you can check out my alternative textures mod for [img]https://imgur.com/SWuwX2z.png[/img] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20265]Giant Crop Junimo Huts[/url]![/size]
